description:
Mission control for Claude Code — browse, search, and drive your Claude Code sessions from a native desktop app.

Monet is a native desktop app that acts as mission control for Claude Code and Codex. Its multi-column workbench lets you browse and search agent sessions, follow tool calls, and drive work across multiple engines from one place, with local data and privacy in mind.
Fixed issues
- #11 UI：建议增加 Compact 工具调用显示模式，减少卡片对阅读流的切割
- #12 Bug：异步子智能体已完成，但任务仍一直显示“进行中”
